}}'''Silene Dorelmin''' is a seamstress in [[Chachin]], [[Kandor]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Silene Dorelmin}}

==Appearance==
Mistress Dorelmin is a slim woman with a haughty air and a cool voice.

==Activities==
Mistress Dorelmin has a formidable reputation as the best seamstress in [[Chachin]]. Her skills came at a significant price, however, as she prepared the dresses needed to get [[Moiraine Damodred]] into the [[Aesdaishar Palace]] during her hunt for the [[Dragon Reborn]].{{ref/book|0|24}}
